description: This file defines the UnchangeablePropertyException class, a custom exception used in the OpenMRS API to signal attempts to modify unchangeable properties on objects.

classes.name: UnchangeablePropertyException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends APIException, thrown when an attempt is made to modify an unchangeable property on an object within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: UnchangeablePropertyException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a detail message.

methods.name: UnchangeablePropertyException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a detail message and a cause.

methods.name: UnchangeablePropertyException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception using a message key and parameters.

methods.name: UnchangeablePropertyException(Class clazz, String property)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating that a specific property of a class cannot be changed.
